flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: pages/Report/index.tsx:61-68 (menu entries without path), pages/Report/action/ActionReport.tsx:36-49 (commented-out resources), utils/models/Fapi.d.ts:308-315 (endpoint comments). No court application report endpoint/generator in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi/thirdpartyapi.
note: 5-point story (status_with_ura: Demo paid 50% of 75%; the SFTP demo_remark is a claim). The story asks for summary reports on court application records that interfaced successfully and with errors. The UI has two menu entries 'Court Application Vault Reports' and 'Court Application Submit Reports' (Report/index.tsx:61-68) but their path is an empty string, they are not rendered in ReportList.tsx, their resource definitions are commented out (ActionReport.tsx:36-49), and the backend has no court application report endpoint (reports/courtcasesummary is only a comment in Fapi.d.ts:308-315). So every step is Tidak ada code. Real State Courts data: cannot verify from repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The Court Application feature (submission to State Courts) is not in the six repos; only comments, TypeScript types and menu placeholders remain. Ask URA/the team in which repo it was built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: After files are interfaced to State Courts, OCMS marks each record as successful or failed
steps.detail: There is no court interface process (see OCMS22.23), so there is no per-record success/failed status. No column or entity for court application interface status exists in the backend.

steps.step: OCMS generates a summary report of court application records that were interfaced successfully
steps.detail: The menu entries 'Court Application Vault Reports' and 'Court Application Submit Reports' are placeholders only: path is an empty string (Report/index.tsx:61-68) and there is no court report list component in Report/lists/index.ts. No report generator exists in the backend.

steps.step: OCMS generates a summary report of records that failed to interface, with the errors
steps.detail: The court report resource definitions in ActionReport.tsx (courtcasesummary) are entirely commented out (ActionReport.tsx:36-49) and the endpoint reports/courtcasesummary/excel is only a comment in Fapi.d.ts:308-315; the backend has no court application report controller. No interface error list exists.

steps.step: The officer opens the report from the Report menu to see successful/failed records
steps.detail: The Report page only renders reports that have a component (ReportList.tsx); the two court application entries have no path or component, so an officer cannot open a report. There is no OCMS_REPORT authorization mapping for court application in api-authorization.properties.
